recipe.title: Mum's vegetable soup
recipe.notes: This recipe comes Mum's mum, Shirley Falconer (née Bowen).
recipe.prep: Bring a large covered pot of salted water to the boil.

method.s: Boil split peas, pearl barley and beef shin for three hours.
Skim off any fat, then add carrot, onion, silverbeet and pepper.
Can store chilled or frozen and reheat as needed.
